SOLDOROS-EGOSWORD_CLARARIS_RELIC.title: Ego Sword - Claris
SOLDOROS-EGOSWORD_CLARARIS_RELIC.descrip: At the start of each combat, add [gold]Ego Sword - Claris[/gold] to your hand.
SOLDOROS-WEAPON_SELECTOR.title: Weapon Selector
SOLDOROS-WEAPON_SELECTOR.description:
Every 7 combats completed,
gain 1 random Relic.
SOLDOROS-WEAPON_SELECTOR.flavor: "A legendary armor said to resonate with surrounding weapons."
SOLDOROS-DEMON_SLAVE.title: Demon Slave
SOLDOROS-DEMON_SLAVE.description:
At the start of each combat,
lose 1 HP. Gain 3 [gold]Strength[/gold].
SOLDOROS-GOLDEN_HAMMER.title: Mighty Dwarf's Golden Hammer
SOLDOROS-GOLDEN_HAMMER.description:
Upon pickup, upgrade 3 random
cards that cost 2 or more.
SOLDOROS-GOLDEN_HAMMER.flavor: "Heavy, but the destructive power is incredible!"
SOLDOROS-HELLO_GUISH.title: Hello Guish
SOLDOROS-HELLO_GUISH.flavor: "Blessed by Guish, a fairy who commands ice magic."
SOLDOROS-SOLDOROS_DECISION.title: Soldoros's Decision
SOLDOROS-SOLDOROS_DECISION.description:
At the start of each combat,
gain 1 [gold]Strength[/gold] for every 5 relics you own.
SOLDOROS-SHAPELESS_SWORD_ELENORE.title: Shapeless Sword Elenore
SOLDOROS-SHAPELESS_SWORD_ELENORE.descrip:
Attack cards deal double damage
to enemies with [gold]Block[/gold].
SOLDOROS-SHAPELESS_SWORD_ELENORE.flavor: "Having no fixed form, the moment you think you've blocked it, you take the hit."
SOLDOROS-HALGIS_BONE_RING.title: Halgi's Bone Ring
SOLDOROS-HALGIS_BONE_RING.description:
Attack cards deal 50% more damage
to enemies that intend to attack.
SOLDOROS-HALGIS_BONE_RING.flavor: "One shot is all you need! Why strike twice or three times? Once is enough. - Cargon"
